lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two federal agents hunting the dark web's biggest drug market were secretly robbing it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The site was Silk Road. Its founder, Ross Ulbricht, got two life sentences.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But a DEA agent on the case had taken bitcoin from him, while pretending to be someone else.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And a Secret Service agent stole over 800,000 dollars in bitcoin from the site itself.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Both were caught. Both went to prison.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The full story is on Unfiled Films.
